title: Golden merge (test-only)
author: mewgenics-mods
description: Test-only overlays for the in-game harness (TDD target 8, golden through dump): one overlay per policy on spawnable enemies — Rat .merge (name + faction), GoldenRat .append (a new entry), Pooter .patch (faction.overwrite, speed.add), two loc rows .append — so the same seeded fight dumps differently with and without this mod. Load it next to _autoplay: `mods: _golden-merge, _autoplay`. Never for play.
